declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Boson.exists_matched_global_gaussian_purification
declarations.reading: An actual pure Gaussian four-party normal density at counts (nA,nB) has finite entropy, equals the all-finite infimum, and beats every finite sidewise competitor.
declarations.limits: Input is an actual BipartiteDensity and IsGaussian. Natural counts include zero. Competitors must satisfy IsSidewisePurifier; no comparison with non-Gaussian purifiers.
declarations.context:
open Module Gaussian.Phase WithLp
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Boson
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_matched_global_gaussian_purification (nA nB : ℕ)
    (ρ : BipartiteDensity nA nB) (hρ : IsGaussian ρ) :
    ∃ σ : FourPartyDensity nA nB nA nB,
      IsSidewisePurifier ρ σ ∧ sidewiseEntropy σ≠⊤ ∧
      sidewiseEntropy σ=gaussianPurificationInfimum nA nB ρ ∧
      ∀ mA mB : ℕ,∀ τ : FourPartyDensity nA nB mA mB,
        IsSidewisePurifier ρ τ → sidewiseEntropy σ≤sidewiseEntropy τ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.exists_matched_global_gaussian_purification
declarations.reading: An actual matched pure Wick density attains the all-finite infimum and beats every independently finite auxiliary pair.
declarations.limits: Input is Density (nA+nB) and IsQuasifree. Both definite total parities are permitted. No separately prescribed parity or non-Gaussian comparison.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_matched_global_gaussian_purification (nA nB : ℕ)
    (ρ : Density (nA+nB)) (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ) :
    ∃ σ : Density ((nA+nB)+(nA+nB)),
      IsSidewisePurifier nA nB nA nB ρ σ ∧
      sidewiseEntropy nA nB nA nB σ=gaussianPurificationInfimum nA nB ρ ∧
      ∀ (mA mB : ℕ) (τ : Density ((mA+mB)+(nA+nB))),
        IsSidewisePurifier nA nB mA mB ρ τ →
          sidewiseEntropy nA nB nA nB σ≤sidewiseEntropy nA nB mA mB τ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Boson.IsGaussianWith
declarations.paper_node: Section 2, centered states and covariance conventions
declarations.reading: Raw Weyl characteristic Gaussianity with symmetric real covariance and a finite real linear mean.
declarations.limits: Normal-density semantics and finite-dimensional real configuration space are inherited. Uncertainty, purity and entropy identities are proved later, not fields.
declarations.context:
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Boson
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
declarations.statement:
def IsGaussianWith (ρ : NormalDensity (Schrodinger E))
    (m : (E × E) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (V : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (E × E)) : Prop :=
  V.IsSymm ∧ ∀ q p, ρ.characteristic q p =
    Complex.exp ((m (q,p) : ℂ)*Complex.I - (V (q,p) (q,p) : ℂ)/4)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.PureCompatibleCovariance
declarations.reading: A symmetric strictly positive bilinear form with a compatible symplectic generator squaring to minus identity.
declarations.limits: This structure is covariance data. Actual normal-density realization and purity require B04; no entropy/minimum is a field.
declarations.context:
open Module
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Phase
variable {E F : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
  [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F]
declarations.statement:
structure PureCompatibleCovariance (Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E) where
  form : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E
  generator : E →ₗ[ℝ] E
  symmetric : form.IsSymm
  positive : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < form x x
  square_neg : ∀ x, generator (generator x) = -x
  compatible : ∀ x y, form x y = Ω x (generator y)
  symplectic : ∀ x y, Ω (generator x) (generator y) = Ω x y

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.BosonicCovariancePurifier
declarations.reading: Any finite auxiliary real symplectic carrier, pure covariance, fixed physical restriction, and nondegenerate auxiliary split.
declarations.limits: Real auxiliary dimension is 2*M. The split is not required to match physical sides; cost and minimum are not fields.
declarations.context:
universe u
open Module
namespace Gaussian.Phase
variable {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
declarations.statement:
structure BosonicCovariancePurifier (V Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E) (M : ℕ) where
  (Auxiliary : Type u)
  [auxAdd : AddCommGroup Auxiliary]
  [auxModule : Module ℝ Auxiliary]
  [auxFinite : FiniteDimensional ℝ Auxiliary]
  commutator : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ Auxiliary
  alternating : commutator.IsAlt
  nondegenerate : commutator.Nondegenerate
  mode_count : finrank ℝ Auxiliary = 2*M
  covariance : PureCompatibleCovariance (productForm Ω commutator)
  physical : ∀ x y, covariance.form (x,0) (y,0) = V x y
  split : Submodule ℝ Auxiliary
  split_nondegenerate : (commutator.restrict split).Nondegenerate

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.exists_bosonic_covariance_selection
declarations.reading: Constructs a complete auxiliary symplectic plane, retains the protected physical space, decreases actual two-form cost, and gives a pure plane at equality.
declarations.limits: Symmetric V, alternating nondegenerate Omega, realified uncertainty, Boolean mode basis, and dim E < 2*dim(Omega-orthogonal A). Equality is for the constructed plane.
declarations.context:
open Module
namespace Gaussian.Phase
variable {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_bosonic_covariance_selection (V Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E)
    (hV : V.IsSymm) (hΩa : Ω.IsAlt) (hΩn : Ω.Nondegenerate)
    (hUnc : Gaussian.Covariance.RealifiedUncertainty V Ω) (A : Submodule ℝ E)
    (hExcess : finrank ℝ E < 2*finrank ℝ (Ω.orthogonal A))
    {n : ℕ} (e : Basis (Fin n × Bool) ℝ E) :
    ∃ P : Submodule ℝ E,
      finrank ℝ P = 2 ∧ P ≤ Ω.orthogonal A ∧ A ≤ Ω.orthogonal P ∧
      (Ω.restrict P).Nondegenerate ∧ (Ω.restrict (Ω.orthogonal P)).Nondegenerate ∧
      IsCompl P (Ω.orthogonal P) ∧ finrank ℝ (Ω.orthogonal P) = 2*(n-1) ∧
      ∃ eU : Basis (Fin (n-1) × Bool) ℝ (Ω.orthogonal P),
        bosonFormCost eU (V.restrict (Ω.orthogonal P)) (Ω.restrict (Ω.orthogonal P))
            (hV.restrict _) (fun x => hΩa x) ≤ bosonFormCost e V Ω hV hΩa ∧
        (bosonFormCost eU (V.restrict (Ω.orthogonal P)) (Ω.restrict (Ω.orthogonal P))
            (hV.restrict _) (fun x => hΩa x) = bosonFormCost e V Ω hV hΩa →
          ∃ p : PureCompatibleCovariance (Ω.restrict P), p.form = V.restrict P)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.PureCompatibleCovariance.exists_auxiliary_subcut_selection
declarations.reading: Selected one-mode plane inside the current auxiliary split has nonincreasing cost; equality supplies pure restricted covariance.
declarations.limits: Pure full covariance, alternating physical/auxiliary forms, both cuts nondegenerate, dim A < dim S. This is the actual same-total deletion interface.
declarations.context:
open Module
namespace Gaussian.Phase
namespace PureCompatibleCovariance
variable {E F : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  {Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E} {σ : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ F}
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_auxiliary_subcut_selection (p : PureCompatibleCovariance (productForm Ω σ))
    (hΩa : Ω.IsAlt) (hσa : σ.IsAlt) (A : Submodule ℝ E) (S : Submodule ℝ F)
    (hA : (Ω.restrict A).Nondegenerate) (hS : (σ.restrict S).Nondegenerate)
    (hExcess : finrank ℝ A < finrank ℝ S) :
    ∃ P : Submodule ℝ S, finrank ℝ P=2 ∧ ((σ.restrict S).restrict P).Nondegenerate ∧
      ((σ.restrict S).restrict ((σ.restrict S).orthogonal P)).Nondegenerate ∧
      IsCompl P ((σ.restrict S).orthogonal P) ∧
      finrank ℝ ((σ.restrict S).orthogonal P) = finrank ℝ S-2 ∧
      p.auxiliaryCutCost A (((σ.restrict S).orthogonal P).map S.subtype) ≤ p.auxiliaryCutCost A S ∧
      (p.auxiliaryCutCost A (((σ.restrict S).orthogonal P).map S.subtype) = p.auxiliaryCutCost A S →
        ∃ q : PureCompatibleCovariance ((σ.restrict S).restrict P),
          ∀ x y : P, q.form x y = p.form (0,(x : S)) (0,(y : S)))

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.PureCompatibleCovariance.invariant_auxiliary_of_subcut_pure

declarations.reading: Pure covariance on the selected subcut makes its embedding invariant under the full pure generator.

variable {E F : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

declarations.reading: An actual all-split fixed-total minimum at M+1 gives a feasible M-mode purifier at no greater cost.

declarations.context:
universe u
open Module
namespace Gaussian.Phase
namespace BosonicCovariancePurifier
variable {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  {V Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E} {M : ℕ}
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_delete_at_minimum (p : BosonicCovariancePurifier V Ω (M+1))
    (hΩa : Ω.IsAlt) (hΩn : Ω.Nondegenerate)
    (A : Submodule ℝ E) (hA : (Ω.restrict A).Nondegenerate)
    (hExcess : finrank ℝ E ≤ 2*M)
    (hmin : ∀ q : BosonicCovariancePurifier V Ω (M+1), p.cost A ≤ q.cost A) :

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.exists_pure_covariance_auxiliary_equiv
declarations.reading: Two raw pure covariances with the same physical restriction and equal finite auxiliary dimension are related by an auxiliary form-preserving equivalence.
declarations.limits: Finite real carriers, nondegenerate physical Omega, exact physical equality, pure-compatible covariances. Includes decoupled pure factors and zero dimensions; no inverse of a singular physical mixed block is assumed.
declarations.context:
open Module
namespace Gaussian.Phase
variable {E F G : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  [AddCommGroup G] [Module ℝ G] [FiniteDimensional ℝ G]
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pure_covariance_auxiliary_equiv
    (Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E) (σ : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ F)
    (τ : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ G) (hΩ : Ω.Nondegenerate)
    (p : PureCompatibleCovariance (productForm Ω σ))
    (q : PureCompatibleCovariance (productForm Ω τ))
    (hd : finrank ℝ F = finrank ℝ G)
    (hphys : ∀ x y, p.form (x,0) (y,0) = q.form (x,0) (y,0)) :
    ∃ Q : F ≃ₗ[ℝ] G,
      (∀ x y, τ (Q x) (Q y) = σ x y) ∧
      (∀ a b x y, q.form (a,Q x) (b,Q y) = p.form (a,x) (b,y))

declarations.name: Gaussian.Phase.PureCompatibleCovariance.exists_auxiliarySubspaceCost_minimum
declarations.reading: At a fixed pure reference covariance the cost attains its minimum over all nondegenerate auxiliary subspaces of a given real dimension.
declarations.limits: Requires nondegenerate physical A and an explicit feasible S0 of the prescribed dimension. No fixed-frame coordinate restriction or externally assumed compactness.
declarations.context:
open Module
namespace Gaussian.Phase
namespace PureCompatibleCovariance
variable {E F : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  {Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E} {σ : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ F}
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_auxiliarySubspaceCost_minimum
    (p : PureCompatibleCovariance (productForm Ω σ)) (A : Submodule ℝ E)
    (hA : (Ω.restrict A).Nondegenerate) {k : ℕ}
    (S₀ : Submodule ℝ F) (hd₀ : finrank ℝ S₀ = k)
    (hnd₀ : (σ.restrict S₀).Nondegenerate) :
    ∃ S : Submodule ℝ F, finrank ℝ S=k ∧ (σ.restrict S).Nondegenerate ∧
      ∀ T : Submodule ℝ F, finrank ℝ T=k → (σ.restrict T).Nondegenerate →
        p.auxiliaryCutCost A S ≤ p.auxiliaryCutCost A T

declarations.name: Gaussian.Attainment.exists_bosonPairCost_minimum
declarations.reading: Continuous covariance/form pairs on a compact parameter family admit an admissible minimum; inverse-form bounds are derived on a finite objective sublevel.
declarations.limits: F compact, V and O continuous, every V on F positive definite, a feasible p0 with det O(p0)!=0. It does not assume all O are invertible or uniform squeezing bounds.
declarations.context:

namespace Gaussian.Attainment
variable {ι X : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [TopologicalSpace X]
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_bosonPairCost_minimum (F : Set X) (hF : IsCompact F)
    (V O : X → HermitianMat ι ℂ) (hV : Continuous V) (hO : Continuous O)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ F, (V p).mat.PosDef)
    (p₀ : X) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ F) (hO₀ : (O p₀).mat.det ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p ∈ F, (O p).mat.det ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ q ∈ F, (O q).mat.det ≠ 0 → bosonPairCost (V p) (O p) ≤ bosonPairCost (V q) (O q)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.realize_skew_contraction

declarations.reading: Every real skew contraction on the finite complete-mode coefficient space is the generator of an actual Wick density.

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.quasifree_eq_of_generator
declarations.reading: Equal trace-defined generators of two actual Wick densities imply equality of densities.
declarations.limits: Both densities must satisfy IsQuasifree. Equality of covariance does not determine arbitrary non-Gaussian states.

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.quasifree_entropy_of_covariance_normal_form
declarations.reading: Genuine matrix entropy equals the sum of one-mode fermionic entropies for the actual covariance normal form.
declarations.limits: IsQuasifree, each signed thermal t in [-1,1], an orthogonal R, and exact covariance pullback equality. A normal form is a proved input to this interface, not a guessed spectrum.
declarations.context:
open scoped BigOperators
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem quasifree_entropy_of_covariance_normal_form (n : ℕ) (ρ : Density n)
    (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ) (t : Fin n → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1)
    (R : CoefficientSpace n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] CoefficientSpace n)
    (hΓ : ∀ a b, covariance ρ a b = covarianceForm (thermal n t ht)
      (R⁻¹ (coefficientBasis n a)) (R⁻¹ (coefficientBasis n b))) :
    Sᵥₙ ρ = ∑ i, Gaussian.Entropy.fermion (t i)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.quasifree_pure_iff_covariancePure
declarations.reading: Actual pure-state existence is equivalent to the trace-defined generator squaring to minus identity.
declarations.limits: Requires IsQuasifree on the full finite occupation space. Not a general density-matrix covariance criterion.
declarations.context:
open Module Gaussian.Phase
open scoped Matrix RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem quasifree_pure_iff_covariancePure (n : ℕ) (ρ : Density n) (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ) :
    (∃ ψ,ρ=MState.pure ψ) ↔ CovariancePure ρ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.selectedRestriction_generator
declarations.reading: Generator of a genuine selected complete-mode restriction is the actual orthogonal compression.
declarations.limits: Retain the implemented orthogonal action and its signed CAR unitary; an unsigned occupation permutation is insufficient.
declarations.context:
open Gaussian.Phase Gaussian.Spectral
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem selectedRestriction_generator (k l : ℕ) (ρ : Density (l+k))
    (R : CoefficientSpace (l+k) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] CoefficientSpace (l+k))
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Occupation (l+k)) ℂ) (hU : Implements (l+k) R U) :
    ∀ x,(selectedCoefficientEmbedding k l R).equivRange
        (covarianceGenerator (prefixRestriction k l (ρ.uConj U)) x) =
      compression (covarianceGenerator ρ)
        (selectedCoefficientEmbedding k l R).toLinearMap.range
        ((selectedCoefficientEmbedding k l R).equivRange x)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.quasifree_entropy_comparison_of_compression
declarations.reading: Actual entropy decreases under an adapted complete-mode compression.
declarations.limits: Two Wick densities, SkewAdaptationData, J-invariant retained U, isometric coefficient identification, and exact generator-compression intertwining are all explicit.
declarations.context:
open Module Gaussian.Phase Gaussian.Spectral
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem quasifree_entropy_comparison_of_compression {n k : ℕ}
    (ρ : Density n) (σ : Density k) (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ) (hσ : IsQuasifree σ)
    (d : SkewAdaptationData (covarianceGenerator ρ))
    (U : Submodule ℝ (CoefficientSpace n)) (hU : d.complexStructure.IsInvariant U)
    (e : CoefficientSpace k ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] U)
    (hT : ∀ x,e (covarianceGenerator σ x)=compression (covarianceGenerator ρ) U (e x)) :
    Sᵥₙ σ ≤ Sᵥₙ ρ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.quasifree_compression_entropy_rigidity
declarations.reading: Exact actual entropy equality forces K=I on the discarded orthogonal complement and zero cross block.
declarations.limits: Retain both Wick predicates, adaptation, J-invariance, isometry, exact generator intertwining and exact entropy equality. No approximate rigidity.
declarations.context:
open Module Gaussian.Phase Gaussian.Spectral
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem quasifree_compression_entropy_rigidity {n k : ℕ}
    (ρ : Density n) (σ : Density k) (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ) (hσ : IsQuasifree σ)
    (d : SkewAdaptationData (covarianceGenerator ρ))
    (V : Submodule ℝ (CoefficientSpace n)) (hV : d.complexStructure.IsInvariant V)
    (e : CoefficientSpace k ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] V)
    (hT : ∀ x,e (covarianceGenerator σ x)=compression (covarianceGenerator ρ) V (e x))
    (he : Sᵥₙ σ=Sᵥₙ ρ) :
    (∀ x ∈ Vᗮ,d.K x=x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Vᗮ,∀ y ∈ V,⟪d.K y,x⟫=0)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.exists_counted_entropy_selection
declarations.reading: Constructs an implemented orthogonal action fixing all protected physical coefficients, with nonincreasing entropy and a pure selected terminal mode at equality.
declarations.limits: A actual Density (1+k), IsQuasifree, and 2*a<1+k. This is c>a when 1+k=a+c. Does not claim a separately prescribed determinant or parity component.
declarations.context:
open Module Gaussian.Phase
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_counted_entropy_selection (a k : ℕ) (hexcess : 2*a<1+k)
    (ρ : Density (1+k)) (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ) :
    ∃ R : CoefficientSpace (1+k) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] CoefficientSpace (1+k),
      ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Occupation (1+k)) ℂ,
      Implements (1+k) R U ∧
      (∀ i : MajoranaIndex a,
        R (coefficientBasis (1+k) (Fin.castLE (by omega : a≤1+k) i.1,i.2)) =
          coefficientBasis (1+k) (Fin.castLE (by omega : a≤1+k) i.1,i.2)) ∧
      Sᵥₙ (prefixRestriction k 1 (ρ.uConj U)) ≤ Sᵥₙ ρ ∧
      (Sᵥₙ (prefixRestriction k 1 (ρ.uConj U))=Sᵥₙ ρ →
        ∃ ψ,suffixRestriction k 1 (ρ.uConj U)=MState.pure ψ)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.exists_A_excess_transfer
declarations.paper_node: Section 5, same-total A-prime to B-prime transfer
declarations.reading: Produces an actual competitor at counts (a,b+1) from (a+1,b), with entropy nonincrease and a pure terminal marginal at exact equality.
declarations.limits: nA<a+1 and actual IsSidewisePurifier. Exact physical density is preserved, both parity components allowed; terminal purity is for this constructed state.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_A_excess_transfer (nA nB a b : ℕ) (hexcess : nA<a+1)
    (ρ : Density (nA+nB)) (σ : Density (((a+1)+b)+(nA+nB)))
    (hσ : IsSidewisePurifier nA nB (a+1) b ρ σ) :
    ∃ τ : Density ((a+(b+1))+(nA+nB)),IsSidewisePurifier nA nB a (b+1) ρ τ ∧
      sidewiseEntropy nA nB a (b+1) τ≤sidewiseEntropy nA nB (a+1) b σ ∧
      (sidewiseEntropy nA nB a (b+1) τ=sidewiseEntropy nA nB (a+1) b σ →
        ∃ ψ,suffixRestriction ((a+b)+(nA+nB)) 1 (modeCountCast (by omega) τ)=MState.pure ψ)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.exists_B_excess_transfer
declarations.reading: Produces an actual competitor at counts (a+1,b) from (a,b+1) with nonincreasing cut entropy.
declarations.limits: nB<b+1 and actual IsSidewisePurifier. The statement supplies a transfer; its conclusion does not include an equality-purity callback.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_B_excess_transfer (nA nB a b : ℕ) (hexcess : nB<b+1)
    (ρ : Density (nA+nB)) (σ : Density ((a+(b+1))+(nA+nB)))
    (hσ : IsSidewisePurifier nA nB a (b+1) ρ σ) :
    ∃ τ : Density (((a+1)+b)+(nA+nB)),
      IsSidewisePurifier nA nB (a+1) b ρ τ ∧
      sidewiseEntropy nA nB (a+1) b τ≤sidewiseEntropy nA nB a (b+1) σ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.exists_sidewise_pure_B_entropy_deletion
declarations.reading: Deletes an explicitly pure terminal B-prime suffix while retaining an actual purifier and exactly the same AA-prime entropy.
declarations.limits: IsSidewisePurifier and CovariancePure of the specified actual suffix after count cast. Arbitrary extra>=0; does not infer purity from an unrelated entropy equality.
declarations.context:
open scoped MState
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sidewise_pure_B_entropy_deletion (nA nB mA mB extra : ℕ) (ρ : Density (nA+nB))
    (σ : Density ((mA+(mB+extra))+(nA+nB)))
    (hσ : IsSidewisePurifier nA nB mA (mB+extra) ρ σ)
    (hs : CovariancePure (suffixRestriction ((mA+mB)+(nA+nB)) extra
      (modeCountCast (by omega) σ))) :
    ∃ τ : Density ((mA+mB)+(nA+nB)),IsSidewisePurifier nA nB mA mB ρ τ ∧
      sidewiseEntropy nA nB mA mB τ=sidewiseEntropy nA nB mA (mB+extra) σ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.isCompact_quasifreePurifiers
declarations.reading: The actual fixed-marginal pure Wick density domain is compact.
declarations.limits: Finite k,l and actual Density k. Compactness permits an empty domain; a minimum additionally requires nonemptiness. This uses density-space compactness rather than literally the paper orbit proof.
declarations.context:
open scoped Matrix BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem isCompact_quasifreePurifiers (k l : ℕ) (ρ : Density k) :
    IsCompact {σ : Density (l+k) | IsPureQuasifree σ ∧ prefixRestriction k l σ=ρ}

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.exists_finiteTotal_minimum
declarations.reading: Chooses an actual minimum simultaneously over all M+1 splits and all actual purifiers.
declarations.limits: Explicit nonempty pure Wick fixed-prefix class at M; no assumption that every smaller M is feasible.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteTotal_minimum (nA nB M : ℕ) (ρ : Density (nA+nB))
    (hne : ∃ σ : Density (M+(nA+nB)),IsPureQuasifree σ ∧ prefixRestriction (nA+nB) M σ=ρ) :
    ∃ (j : Fin (M+1)) (σ : Density (M+(nA+nB))),
      IsPureQuasifree σ ∧ prefixRestriction (nA+nB) M σ=ρ ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin (M+1)) (τ : Density (M+(nA+nB))),
        IsPureQuasifree τ → prefixRestriction (nA+nB) M τ=ρ →
        finiteTotalEntropy nA nB M j σ≤finiteTotalEntropy nA nB M i τ

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.finitePurifier_attainment
declarations.reading: Constructed Gaussian purification and padding discharge nonemptiness, giving actual fixed-total attainment.
declarations.limits: Input IsQuasifree and M>=nA+nB. No separately assumed minimum or covariance realization.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePurifier_attainment (nA nB : ℕ) (ρ : Density (nA+nB)) (hρ : IsQuasifree ρ)
    (M : ℕ) (hM : nA+nB≤M) :
    ∃ p : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ M,
      ∀ x : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ M,finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ M p≤finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ M x

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.finitePurifier_optimal_delete
declarations.reading: An actual M+1 fixed-total minimum reduces to a feasible M-mode point with no greater cost, whichever side is excessive.
declarations.limits: M>=nA+nB and exact comparison against every all-split FinitePurifier at M+1. Transfer precedes equality and removal.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePurifier_optimal_delete (nA nB : ℕ) (ρ : Density (nA+nB)) (M : ℕ)
    (hM : nA+nB≤M) (p : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ (M+1))
    (hp : ∀ x : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ (M+1),
      finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ (M+1) p≤finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ (M+1) x) :
    ∃ q : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ M,
      finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ M q≤finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ (M+1) p

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.finitePurifier_padding
declarations.reading: Every feasible point at M pads to L with exactly unchanged real entropy.
declarations.limits: M<=L and an actual finite purifier. No purity, marginal or entropy equivalence is postulated without construction.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePurifier_padding (nA nB : ℕ) (ρ : Density (nA+nB)) (M L : ℕ) (hML : M≤L)
    (p : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ M) :
    ∃ q : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ L,
      finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ L q=finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ M p

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.finitePurifier_matchSplit
declarations.reading: At total nA+nB an actual finite purifier can be reallocated to counts (nA,nB) without raising entropy.
declarations.limits: Requires an actual feasible p at that total. It need not already minimize, and the conclusion is nonincrease rather than equality; global minimality supplies equality when needed.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePurifier_matchSplit (nA nB : ℕ) (ρ : Density (nA+nB))
    (p : FinitePurifier nA nB ρ (nA+nB)) :
    ∃ σ : Density ((nA+nB)+(nA+nB)),
      IsSidewisePurifier nA nB nA nB ρ σ ∧
      sidewiseEntropy nA nB nA nB σ≤finitePurifierCost nA nB ρ (nA+nB) p

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Fermion.pure_quasifree_has_definiteParity
declarations.paper_node: Section 2 and Appendix B, main parity convention
declarations.reading: An actual pure Wick density has some definite total parity.
declarations.limits: Existence of some parity does not prescribe which parity the matched optimizer has. Supporting scope theorem, not the optional fixed-parity strengthening.
declarations.context:
open scoped Matrix
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Fermion
declarations.statement:
theorem pure_quasifree_has_definiteParity {n : ℕ} (ρ : Density n) (hρ : IsPureQuasifree ρ) :
    ∃ odd : Bool,HasParity ρ odd

declarations.name: Gaussian.Entropy.boson_compression_comparison
declarations.reading: Finite real self-adjoint compression entropy half-sum comparison.
declarations.limits: Finite real inner-product space, true orthogonal compression U, exact full/retained dimension counts; K symmetric and K-I positive. This coefficient theorem alone has no physical state semantics; B09 or F07/F08 supply the bridge.
declarations.context:
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
open Gaussian.Spectral
namespace Gaussian.Entropy
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
variable [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {K : E →ₗ[ℝ] E}
declarations.statement:
theorem boson_compression_comparison (hK : K.IsSymmetric)
    (hd : (K-LinearMap.id).IsPositive) (U : Submodule ℝ E)
    {m c : ℕ} (hn : Module.finrank ℝ E = m+c) (hm : Module.finrank ℝ U = m) :
    realListCost boson ((compression_symmetric hK U).eigenvalues hm) ≤
      realListCost boson (hK.eigenvalues hn)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Entropy.fermion_compression_comparison
declarations.reading: Finite real self-adjoint compression entropy half-sum comparison.
declarations.limits: Finite real inner-product space, true orthogonal compression U, exact full/retained dimension counts; K positive and I-K positive. This coefficient theorem alone has no physical state semantics; B09 or F07/F08 supply the bridge.
declarations.context:
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
open Gaussian.Spectral
namespace Gaussian.Entropy
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
variable [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {K : E →ₗ[ℝ] E}
declarations.statement:
theorem fermion_compression_comparison (hK : K.IsPositive)
    (hd : (LinearMap.id-K).IsPositive) (U : Submodule ℝ E)
    {c m : ℕ} (hn : Module.finrank ℝ E = c+m) (hm : Module.finrank ℝ U = m) :
    realListCost fermion ((compression_symmetric hK.isSymmetric U).eigenvalues hm) ≤
      realListCost fermion (hK.isSymmetric.eigenvalues hn)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Entropy.boson_compression_rigidity
declarations.reading: Finite real self-adjoint compression rigidity: endpoint identity and vanishing cross block.
declarations.limits: Finite real inner-product space, true orthogonal compression U, exact full/retained dimension counts; K symmetric, K-I positive, exact half-sum equality. This coefficient theorem alone has no physical state semantics; B09 or F07/F08 supply the bridge.
declarations.context:
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
open Gaussian.Spectral
namespace Gaussian.Entropy
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
variable [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {K : E →ₗ[ℝ] E}
declarations.statement:
theorem boson_compression_rigidity (hK : K.IsSymmetric)
    (hd : (K-LinearMap.id).IsPositive) (U : Submodule ℝ E)
    {m c : ℕ} (hn : Module.finrank ℝ E = m+c) (hm : Module.finrank ℝ U = m)
    (he : realListCost boson ((compression_symmetric hK U).eigenvalues hm) =
      realListCost boson (hK.eigenvalues hn)) :
    (∀ x ∈ Uᗮ, K x = x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Uᗮ, ∀ y ∈ U, ⟪K y,x⟫ = 0)

declarations.name: Gaussian.Optimization.global_attained_from_optimal_deletion
declarations.paper_node: Section 5, induction over all finite totals
declarations.reading: An actual n-total witness beats every feasible finite-total point, including totals below n.
declarations.limits: Three explicit premises: exact attainment for all M>=n, deletion only at an attained M+1 optimum, and padding from each M<n to n. A generic theorem; sector-specific discharges B19/B15/B20 or F15/F16/F17 are mandatory.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Optimization
declarations.statement:
theorem global_attained_from_optimal_deletion
    (E : ℕ → Type*) (cost : ∀ M, E M → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (attain : ∀ M, n ≤ M → ∃ p : E M, ∀ x : E M, cost M p ≤ cost M x)
    (delete : ∀ M, n ≤ M → ∀ p : E (M+1),
      (∀ x : E (M+1), cost (M+1) p ≤ cost (M+1) x) →
      ∃ q : E M, cost M q ≤ cost (M+1) p)
    (pad : ∀ M, M < n → ∀ x : E M, ∃ y : E n, cost n y ≤ cost M x) :
    ∃ p : E n, ∀ M, ∀ x : E M, cost n p ≤ cost M x

declarations.name: Gaussian.Optimization.exists_matched_cost_le_of_unit_moves
declarations.reading: Finite iteration reaches a specified natural index at nonincreasing cost.
declarations.limits: Every point below target admits a +1 move, every point above target admits a -1 move, each nonincreasing. It does not independently prove admissibility, compactness or a global optimum.
declarations.context: namespace Gaussian.Optimization
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_matched_cost_le_of_unit_moves {E : Type*} (index : E → ℕ)
    (cost : E → ℝ) (target : ℕ)
    (up : ∀ x,index x<target → ∃ y,index y=index x+1 ∧ cost y≤cost x)
    (down : ∀ x,target < index x → ∃ y,index y+1=index x ∧ cost y≤cost x)
    (x : E) : ∃ y,index y=target ∧ cost y≤cost x

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Boson.NormalDensity
declarations.reading: Positive trace-class operator of trace one on the full complete complex Hilbert space.
declarations.limits: Schrodinger E is the full L2 space in B01, not a finite Fock cutoff. Gaussianity is a separate raw predicate.
declarations.context:
open ProbabilisticTheory
open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Boson
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
declarations.statement:
structure NormalDensity (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] where
  operator : TraceClass H
  nonneg : 0 ≤ operator.1
  trace_one : normalTrace operator = 1

declarations.name: Gaussian.Physical.Boson.NormalDensity.entropy
declarations.reading: Trace norm of the positive CFC -rho log rho operator if trace class, otherwise infinity.
declarations.limits: Defined on arbitrary normal densities before a Gaussian spectrum is identified. B03 separately proves finiteness and the cost equality.
declarations.context:
open ProbabilisticTheory
open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace ENNReal
namespace Gaussian.Physical.Boson
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
declarations.statement:
def NormalDensity.entropy (ρ : NormalDensity H) : ℝ≥0∞ := by
  classical
  exact if h : IsTraceClass ρ.entropyOperator then ENNReal.ofReal (traceNorm ρ.entropyOperator h) else ∞

declarations.name: Gaussian.Covariance.RealifiedUncertainty
declarations.reading: Positivity of the complex uncertainty quadratic form written using real coefficient vectors.
declarations.limits: V symmetry and Omega alternation/nondegeneracy are separate premises when needed. Sign conventions are equivalent because the second vector ranges freely.
declarations.context:
namespace Gaussian.Covariance
variable {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
declarations.statement:
def RealifiedUncertainty (V Ω : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, 0 ≤ V x x + V y y - 2 * Ω x y
